notes: Web 426 — FUEL-PHOTO-SYNC-NOV11 (Nov 11, 2026; layers on web 425). The owner's 18:57 CST screenshot and question: tonight's fill (Shell #110, 110.292 L, $239.22, odo 172,726), filed through the WEB session with the receipt photo attached and confirmed there, synced to his phone with its figures exact — but the phone's row paints NO thumbnail, while the Nov 9 and Nov 10 rows (photos attached on the phone itself) show theirs. 'Why is there no receipt attached to the fuel today?' PROVEN ROOT (bench, two surfaces over one account, the real module code both sides): the send side is innocent — the add form's save writes the per-record photo document under its stable key and the figures/photo land; the book's sync copy sheds the photo fields by the v289 design, so the receiving surface's only source is that document, read back by the v350 heal. The heal ran ONCE per page session (photoGraftRan): the first Fuel render of the session spent it, snapshotting the photo-less records of that moment. Tonight's fill arrived by sync pull AFTER the phone's Fuel module had already rendered that day, so it was never looked up — it would only have healed at the next full app restart. THE FIX (modules/fuel.js only): the blanket became a per-record ledger (photoGraftTried) — a photo-less record is looked up the first time it is SEEN photo-less (a new arrival is a new key, healed on the very next render, same session), and again only after a 5-minute retry window, so a document that lands late or room that frees up still heals in-session while repeated renders of an unchanged book spend no reads; matching, grafting, the fit ladder and the once-a-day legacy scan keep their v350–v373 behaviour exactly. Both receipt slots travel (photo + the photos stack ride the same document and the same graft). Nothing else touched: phone-local photos (Nov 9/10) keep showing, photo-less cloud entries stay photo-less, every fact byte-identical. Bench: the new suite tools/fuel-photo-travel-nov11-test.js — T1 tonight's exact sequence (render, file on web, pull, re-render) FAILED on 425 bytes (photo absent, no thumbnail) and passes now; T2 the v350 arrival-before-open shape still heals; T3 a two-receipt fill lands BOTH photos on the receiving copy; T4 a nowhere-photo stays photo-less, an immediate re-open spends no further reads, and a late-landing document heals after the window in the same session; T5 the phone's own entries and every fact are undisturbed. Fuel family standings vs the 425 baseline are unchanged (the only failures anywhere are the pre-existing stale version pins in old suites). TONIGHT'S OWN ENTRY: the web session that filed it ran the shipped save path, which writes the photo document before anything can shed it — and that same session's book write demonstrably reached his phone, so the document is in his account; with 426 his phone heals tonight's photo the next time the Fuel module renders (no re-attach needed). Only if that one write had silently died would the photo need a one-time re-attach from his own gallery.
